headline: Committee hears sister city plan and disaster donation bills

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: The committee discussed a new Philippines sister city and three emergency donation bills, then recessed before a vote on Bill 142.
meeting.recap: A Maui Filipino Community Council member testified that the city is growing.[[0:15:00]] The committee discussed a resolution making the capital city of Ilocos Norte, Philippines, a sister city.[[0:20:29]] The chair said the council adopted the resolution on September 29th, 2026.[[0:21:00]] A County official said the next step is signing a memorandum of agreement (a formal written agreement).[[0:25:32]] A community council presenter named four areas for ties: tourism and culture, agriculture, trade, and education and health.[[0:32:56]] He suggested an ad hoc committee (a special working group) to explore more ideas.[[0:37:17]] The chair deferred (postponed) the item.[[1:01:34]] Bill 142 would let the mayor accept and use disaster donations during a declared emergency, and for one year after, without council approval first.[[1:02:30]] Bill 132 would add a $100,000 disaster donation line to the fiscal year 27 budget.[[1:03:40]] The deputy finance director shared a staff idea to change code wording to "disaster recovery and related expenditures.".[[1:06:12]] The budget director said the administration supports the revised bills.[[1:08:37]] A council member said people were not sure where to send donations.[[1:09:20]] A member moved to recommend passing Bill 142 on first reading.[[1:16:58]] The chair called a 10-minute recess to get the amendment wording right.[[1:17:29]]
decided: A member moved to recommend passage of Bill 142 on first reading, and the chair called a recess before any vote.
meeting.next: A County official said a ceremonial gathering will follow the signing of the memorandum of agreement. The chair asked about sending a letter to the Sister City Foundation for its list of cities waiting to be considered. A speaker said the intent is to create a list of nonprofits before any disaster.

moments.q: "No legislative action will be taken under this item."

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

issues.oneLine: The committee reviewed three bills on money donated to the County during an emergency.
issues.why: A council member said people were not sure where to send donations, and some groups asking for money are bad actors.
issues.brief: Bill 142 would let the mayor accept and use disaster donations during a declared emergency, and for one year after, without council approval first.[[#1]] A revised version of Bill 131 would make quarterly reports to the council mandatory.[[#2]] Bill 132 would add a $100,000 disaster donation line to the fiscal year 27 budget.[[#3]] The budget director said the administration supports the revised bills.[[#4]]
